noAccess.title: No access to Sales
noAccess.body: This app needs the App.Sales role. Request it in Orbit under “Request access”.

ghl_not_configured.title: GHL is not connected
ghl_not_configured.body: GHL_API_TOKEN and GHL_LOCATION_ID are missing in Railway. Without them Sales cannot load meetings, follow-ups or deals.

no_ghl_user.title: No GHL user for {email}
no_ghl_user.body: Sales shows the data of the GHL user with the same email as your Microsoft account. Create a GHL user with {email} or change that user's email.

ghl_failed.title: GHL is not responding
ghl_failed.body: The GHL user list could not be loaded. Check that the token has the users.readonly scope, then reload.

viewing: You are viewing {name}'s day. Follow-ups you create here are assigned to {name}.

dialog.title: Add follow-up
dialog.suggesting: Noah is reading the call and suggesting the next step …
dialog.noteFromCall: Save the call summary as a note in GHL
dialog.hint: Created in GHL as a task on the contact.
dialog.noClaude: Without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY there is no suggestion. Enter the next step yourself.
dialog.suggestFailed: The suggestion could not be created. Enter the next step yourself or try again.
dialog.forbidden: This contact is assigned to another sales rep.
dialog.noContacts: No matching contact. Create it in GHL first.
